provenance.modifications: Four selected NaPALIS units. Esri clockwise shells/counterclockwise holes reconstructed without repair. Topology-preserving simplification at at most 0.0005 degrees, 8-decimal coordinates, all islands/holes retained and at most 2% symmetric area change.
provenance.limitations: North Island and Rakiura national park pilot, not complete conservation-land coverage. Other reserves, marine areas, Te Urewera and offshore conservation islands omitted. South Island retains its separately reviewed existing nine-park/DOC layer. Boundaries do not establish current access, track conditions, bird occurrence or certification. Respect closures, permits and cultural guidance.
